title: 696. Map Sum Pairs

examples.explanation: After apple=3, prefix ap sums to 3. After app=2, prefix ap sums to 3+2=5.
The second insert overwrites aa to 3, so prefix a sums to 3.

hints: Design adaptation: implement runMapSum(operations, keys, vals); insert uses keys[i]/vals[i], sum uses keys[i] as the prefix and ignores vals[i].
Keep a map from full key to its current value; overwrites replace the old value.
A sum scans all stored keys with the given prefix and adds their values.
